xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: The above financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on 9.11.2023. The Financial Results have been prepared in accordance with Ind AS prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 and in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The Company has approved the sale of sugar and distillery units at Dhenkanal and Soya Unit at Pollachi at competitve prices for the purpose of raising funds to reduce the liabilities. During the financial year 2022-23 the Company has sold the Sugar and Distillery Units at Dhenkanal for a consideration of Rs.134110 lakhs on slump sale basis and recognised Rs.5624.98 lakhs as profit. The details relating to discontinued operations are furnished below: For the Quarter ended 30.9.2023 (Rs. in lakhs) Total Income: 4456.58, Total Expenses: 4448.99 Profit Before Tax: 7.79, Tax Expenses: 7.74, Profit After Tax: 0.05. For the Period ended 30.9.2023 (Rs. in lakhs) Total Income: 7677.17, Total Expenses: 7909.62 Loss Before Tax: 232.45, Tax Expenses: -57.74, Loss After Tax: 174.71 The Auditors have qualified their report for the quarter ended 30.9.2023 as under: No provision for the expected credit loss/impairment on interest receivable from an erstwhile associate company of Rs.25219.69 lakhs have been recognised as per the requirement of IndAS 109. Inveiw of the non-reccovery and in absence of clear forward looking information regarding outcome of pending legal action, we are unable to determine the amount of expected credit loss/impairment and consequential impact on results. This matter was qualified by the Auditor in their report on the financial statements for the year ended 31.3.3023. Board has addressed the qualification stating that their confident of obtaining favourable award and hence ECL is not provided. Exceptional item represents remission of interest liability on secured borrowings as per relevant agreement.
